source.title: A Most Curious Gnome
source.description:
What we need to finish this mission exists right here in Andorhal, it just isn't here right now.

The room behind me contains a "gnome" named Chromie. She's a rather curious creature who is is known to utilize a very  special type of draconic magic. Time magic, in point of fact.

If we could convince her to use her magic to help us, we might be able to reach through time briefly and get what we need. It's a gambit, but it just might be our only option. See if you can convince her to lend us her aid.
source.objective: Speak with Chromie in Andorhal and convince her to help you.
source.completion: It's great to see you again, <name>! At least I think we've met already. We've met right? It gets hard to keep track of all the different versions of each person I've met... or will meet.
